properties.Mechanism (MOA): Competitive muscarinic antagonist → blocks parasympathetic effects: eye (mydriasis), glands (↓secretions), heart (↑HR via M2 block), GI/GU smooth muscle (↓motility, urinary retention). Antidote concept: blocks M-mediated cholinergic excess.
properties.Contraindications: Angle-closure glaucoma; prostatic hypertrophy/urinary retention risk.
properties.Indications: Organophosphate poisoning rescue (high-yield); bradycardia; pre-op secretion reduction; visceral spasm.
properties.Adverse effects: Dry mouth, blurred vision/mydriasis, constipation, urinary retention, tachycardia; confusion (especially in older adults).
